description: Java class defining InteropResponseData, a data structure for interoperation responses in the Fineract project, including date formatting and builder methods.

classes.name: InteropResponseData
classes.description: A data class representing the response data for interoperation, including transaction code, state, expiration, and extensions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances of InteropResponseData with various parameter combinations.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the interop response.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Returns the expiration date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getExpirationDate
methods.description: Returns the expiration as a LocalDateTime object.

methods.name: getExtensionList
methods.description: Returns the list of extension data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string into a LocalDateTime object.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a LocalDateTime into a string with timezone info.
